description: Create a house hunting comparison spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/house_comparison.xlsx. Add column headers: Address, Price, Square Feet, Bedrooms, Bathrooms, Price per Sq Ft. Enter data for 4 properties (742 Evergreen Terrace: $385,000, 2100 sqft, 3bd/2ba; 1640 Riverside Drive: $425,000, 2450 sqft, 4bd/2.5ba; 344 Clinton Way: $310,000, 1650 sqft, 2bd/2ba; 2311 North Los Robles: $468,000, 2800 sqft, 4bd/3ba). Create formulas in column F to calculate price per square foot (=B/C). Format columns B and F as currency. Add summary row with 'Best Value (Lowest $/SqFt):' label and MIN formula to find lowest price per sq ft. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
